title: Hypertron: Efficiently Scaling Large Models by Exploring High-Dimensional Parallelization Space
problem: Large model training on parallel machines is inefficient due to limited parallelization strategy space; dense and sparse models with long context require diverse strategies
motivation: Model scale growing rapidly; existing strategies (data/tensor/pipeline parallelism) are sub-optimal; high-dimensional strategy exploration could unlock better scaling
method: Hypertron framework: unprecedented 7D parallelization space; holistic dimension fusion scheme; comprehensive performance model; high-dimensional exploration on Ascend NPU accelerators
key_novelty: 7D parallelization space supporting dense/sparse models; optimal strategy discovery not supported by existing frameworks; significant memory and communication reduction
contributions: 56.7% MFU on 2048 Ascend NPUs; 1.33x speedup over state-of-the-art
limitations: Evaluation limited to Ascend accelerators; generalization to other hardware unclear
primary_theme: High-dimensional parallelization strategy optimization for large models
